definitions.gloss: to be in time for, to make it
definitions.explanation: To arrive or complete something before a deadline or scheduled time.

definitions.gloss: to be sufficient, to serve the purpose
definitions.explanation: For something to be adequate or good enough for a purpose.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (be in time for X, sense 1); Y⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う (Y is enough, sense 2). The particle is what separates the two senses in practice.

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is uncommon. The verb describes reaching a threshold, so it appears mostly in the past ({間|ま}に{合|あ}った, we made it), the negative ({間|ま}に{合|あ}わない, we won't make it), or the potential-like future reading of the plain form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: make the train
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: meet the deadline
- {間|ま}に{合|あ}わない: won't make it, won't be ready
- ⟦ギリギリ→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: barely make it
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: this will do

USAGE:
{間|ま}に{合|あ}って⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧ is a standard polite refusal — literally 'I'm already supplied,' used to turn down a salesperson or an offer, roughly English 'No thank you, I'm all set.' It is one of the few places the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form is idiomatic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる→間に合わせる：30385_maniawaseru⟧: the transitive counterpart — get something done in time, or make do with something
- ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: the second element of the compound, to match or fit
- ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: also 'be enough,' but purely about quantity, with none of sense 1's time meaning

COMPOUND STRUCTURE: {間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (into the interval, in time) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to match, to meet). The noun {間|ま}に{合|あ}わせ (a makeshift, a stopgap) is derived from the transitive form.
